capabilities.name: Sign up free and get set up in a few guided steps
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Start free with your name, email address and a password; no payment card is asked for. A few short welcome steps connect your sources and ask about your company, then take you straight to the AI chat.
limits: Plans cannot be bought online; they are set up in a conversation.

claims_not_made: set up in N minutes (any time figure)

capabilities.name: Connect GitHub and get a first model built from your repositories
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Connect GitHub when you sign up or later from Connections. Entelim reads your repositories and adds the applications, the technology they run on and the links between them to your model, each marked as read from GitHub, and shows you what it added.
limits: Only GitHub is read: GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps are not connected.
Jira is not used to build your model.

claims_not_made: any time figure for the read

capabilities.name: Bring a product's GitHub repositories into its product page
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: From a product's page, pick repositories from your GitHub connection. Entelim proposes the components, services, interfaces and technology they show, already linked to that product, and once you accept them each one links to the file it was read from.
limits: It reads the repositories you pick, not your whole codebase.

capabilities.name: Application inventory with a page for each application
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Keep one list of your applications. Each has its own page with its owner, lifecycle, the capabilities it supports, the technology and suppliers your model links to it and the framework requirements linked to it, and you can edit and save its details.
limits: Applications are added by you or read from GitHub; Entelim does not find every application on its own.

claims_not_made: shows which requirements you comply with

capabilities.name: Named owners for applications
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Record who owns each application, choose the owner by name, and ask the AI chat who owns a system; it names the owner recorded in your model.
limits: Owners are recorded by hand; they are not imported from an HR system or directory.

claims_not_made: owners imported from your HR system or directory
owners kept up to date automatically

capabilities.name: Business capability map
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Build your business capability map: add, edit and remove capabilities and see them as a map or a list.
limits: The starter selections are a starting point, not a full reference model for every industry.

claims_not_made: a complete industry reference model for every industry

capabilities.name: Link applications to the capabilities they support
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Link each application to the business capabilities it supports, with how fully it supports each one, and see those links on the application's page or by asking the AI chat.
limits: Links are made by people; Entelim does not find every capability an application supports.

claims_not_made: finds every capability an application supports

capabilities.name: Business model canvas
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Create a business model canvas for your company and edit each of its blocks.
limits: There is no export to PowerPoint and no Lean Canvas.

claims_not_made: AI writes your canvas for you

capabilities.name: Gap register (gap analysis)
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Record the gaps between your current and target architecture, each with its kind, severity and the element it concerns, link each gap to the work package that closes it, and see the same gap counts on every page.
limits: Gaps are recorded by people; Entelim does not find them for you.

capabilities.name: Work packages that close gaps
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Plan the work that closes each gap as work packages, each showing its capability, owner, status and dates in one place, with a link to add whatever is missing.
limits: There are no Gantt charts or resource planning, and no synchronisation with Jira.

capabilities.name: Roadmap of gaps across plateaus
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: See your gaps on a roadmap of plateaus, the stages between your current architecture and your target, opened from the Gaps page.
limits: It shows the order of the work, not a dated timeline or a Gantt chart.

claims_not_made: plans dates and resources for you

capabilities.name: Risk register
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Keep a risk register: record, edit and close risks, and see how many are open and how many are critical.
limits: Risks are recorded and rated; Entelim does not work out a financial loss.

capabilities.name: What breaks if a system fails
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Pick a system, or ask in the AI chat, and see what depends on it: the applications, processes and capabilities affected if it fails, each linked to its record, and where each connection came from.
limits: It follows the links recorded in your model; it does not find dependencies nobody has recorded.

claims_not_made: finds dependencies nobody has recorded or connected

capabilities.name: Scenarios: try a change on a copy of your model
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Try a change, such as retiring a system, on a copy of your model and see what it does to your elements, links, applications and open risks before you change anything real. Save scenarios and compare them side by side.
limits: Scenarios compare what you enter; Entelim does not forecast savings or the cost of a change.

claims_not_made: predicts the cost of a change

capabilities.name: AI chat with answers that cite their sources
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Ask questions about your architecture in plain language, on a desktop or a phone: who owns a system, what breaks if it fails, which capabilities it supports. Answers cite their sources, and you can open the records behind them.
limits: It answers from what is recorded in your model, not about the rest of your business.

claims_not_made: every source in every answer is a link
instant answers or any time figure
answers any question about your business
anything about how citations are produced or numbered

capabilities.name: Ask the AI chat to correct a record
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Ask the AI chat to correct a record, such as an application's description, and it changes only that record when you press Save.

claims_not_made: the AI changes your model on its own
a person approves every AI change in a queue

capabilities.name: Connect your own AI assistant (MCP)
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Connect an AI assistant that supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to your organisation's model. You allow the connection with your Entelim sign-in; the assistant can then search your model and ask what breaks, who is accountable and what is at risk, reading only your organisation's data, and you can disconnect it at any time.
limits: The connection reads your model; it does not change it.

claims_not_made: writes to or changes your model
an official connector of a named assistant product
tested with, listed by or endorsed by a named AI company

capabilities.name: ArchiMate modelling in the browser
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Model your architecture in ArchiMate in the browser: create and edit elements in every layer, draw and save diagrams in the Composer, open any element with everything it connects to, and explore the whole model on the model map.

claims_not_made: any count of element or relationship types
every layer count agrees on every screen

capabilities.name: Vendors your model already links to your systems
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: The Vendors page lists the suppliers your model links to your systems, and you can record any of them as a managed vendor in one step.
limits: There are no contract renewal alerts, vendor risk scores or spend analytics.

capabilities.name: Consolidation opportunities from your own model
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Consolidation Opportunities ranks the applications you could merge or retire, worked out from your own model, and each row opens that application's page.
limits: It points out opportunities; it gives no saving figure and decides nothing for you.

capabilities.name: Backlog prioritisation with the evidence behind each score
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Rank your backlog: every card shows a score worked out from its own inputs with the evidence beneath it, and names the input to add when one is missing.
limits: It orders the work for you to review, and is not synchronised with Jira.

capabilities.name: Investment prioritisation matrix
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: An investment prioritisation matrix shows your capabilities, and its totals agree with your capability map.
limits: It places applications in the matrix; it does not recommend where to invest or give a return figure.

capabilities.name: Cost figures only for people allowed to see spending
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Cost figures are shown only to people whose role lets them see spending; everyone else sees the rest of the page with a plain note that costs are withheld.

capabilities.name: Each organisation's model kept separate
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Each organisation's model is kept separate: people in one organisation cannot find or open another organisation's records.

claims_not_made: data stays in a named country or region

capabilities.name: Business cases
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Build a business case for an investment from its costs and benefits and keep it with the rest of your model.
limits: It does not give a return or payback figure.

capabilities.name: A sample company to try Entelim
capabilities.what_a_person_can_do: Load a sample company to see Entelim working before you connect your own tools.

capabilities.name: Import the BIAN landscape
capabilities.what_exists: When a company chooses 'Banking and payments' at sign-up, Entelim loads a BIAN starter selection: business areas as top-level capabilities and service domains beneath them. It is a starting point, not the full BIAN landscape.

provenance.recorded_text: A BIAN starter selection (business areas as level 1 capabilities, service domains as level 2) is loaded when a company chooses 'Banking and payments' at sign-up. The code's own description: 'a starting point ... not the full landscape' (,  INDUSTRIES at 7f59c3b70).
